Label instabox-medium: 4 vCPU, 8 GiB, fresh Ubuntu 24.04 machine with the tools of GitHub's ubuntu-24.04 image (runner-images ubuntu24/20261026.354), usable on every plan including Free (instabox.sh/docs/ci.md, read 2026-11-14). Architecture is unknown: the docs do not state x86 for the ci template, so read the arch and CPU model the job's fingerprint reports; shared vs dedicated vCPUs is not stated either. Price $0.034/hour (about $0.000567/minute), derived from Instabox unit prices $0.004 per vCPU-hour and $0.00225 per GiB-hour of memory, metered by the second while the machine runs (instabox.sh/docs/pricing.md, read 2026-11-14): 4 x 0.004 + 8 x 0.00225. CI billing is not stated separately, pending invoice check against the observed charge; a 15-minute job estimates at most $0.0085. Paid plans include monthly credits, so the invoice may show the usage drawn from credits. Terms of Service (instabox.sh/terms, operated by InsForge, 'Last updated November 9, 2026', read 2026-11-14) contain no benchmark, comparison or publication clause; section 2(b)(iv) forbids circumventing usage limits, quotas, metering or billing controls, which this suite does not do. No hard billing cutoff is asserted; the 15-minute job timeout is not a billing cap. Canary run 43628223138 (2026-11-14, node-typescript, repeat 1) succeeded: the runner was assigned within about 40 seconds of dispatch, fingerprint AMD EPYC, 4 vCPU, Ubuntu 24.04.5, kernel 6.18.60-instabox (architecture still not stated by the fingerprint file); the job ran 8 min 51 s (18:44:37Z to 18:53:28Z), derived cost 531 s x $0.034/3600 = $0.0050. Observed charge: the Instabox account is on the Free plan (tier free), where GET /v1/usage reports costUSD $0 and allowanceUSD $0 for any usage ('a free machine is never billed'), so no dollar charge can be observed on Free; the metered counters (vcpuHours, memGiBHours) did not move between 18:54Z and the 19:00Z rating and cannot yet be attributed to the canary. The CI rate therefore remains derived and unverified, and no paid-plan invoice check has been done. The pilot is paused after the canary until that check.
